file_change.purpose: Expose the minimum self-hosting workflow as deterministic command-line entry points for AI and human actors.
implementation: Provide subcommands: design-check, design-assure, functional-set-check, plan-check, planning-assure, plan-accept, build-open, build-check, build-assure, build-accept, status.
All commands accept explicit repository root and artifact paths; no hidden current-directory authority.
Return nonzero on failed Conformance/Assurance/acceptance and emit deterministic JSON summaries suitable for agent use.
CLI dispatches to domain modules and contains no independent policy semantics.
Accept durable evidence references for Assurance and persist Assurance output when requested.
Load explicit authority-state artifacts and resolve acceptance evidence before invoking Governance acceptance.
Persist explicit acceptance records to durable repository evidence.
Run accepted Plan mechanical validation as part of Build checking and optionally persist validation-run and Build Conformance evidence.
Delegate policy semantics to evidence, validation, conformance, assurance, governance, and build domain modules rather than implementing independent CLI policy.
